description:
Simplify the geometry of country boundaries for a web map application.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the shapefile '/home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.shp'.
3. Use the 'Simplify' tool (Vector > Geometry Tools > Simplify) to reduce the detail of the polygons.
4. Set the simplification method to Distance (Douglas-Peucker) and the Tolerance to 0.05 degrees.
5. Export the result as a GeoJSON file to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/countries_simplified.geojson'. Ensure the file is saved with CRS EPSG:4326 (WGS 84).
6. The output should contain roughly the same number of countries but with significantly fewer vertices.
